step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows an end-to-end data lake processing pattern at iRobot. 1. External IoT data/data pipeline streams raw JSON data into an S3 bucket (JSON). 2. A Glue Crawler scans the JSON data in S3 and registers schema metadata into the Glue Data Catalog. 3. A Glue ETL job reads the JSON records from the first S3 bucket and converts them into Parquet format, writing them to a second S3 bucket. 4. A second Glue Crawler scans the Parquet S3 bucket and updates the Glue Data Catalog. 5. Amazon Athena reads the schema from the Glue Data Catalog to run SQL queries directly on the data in S3.
